$comment: Mission 1.82. The semantic input Mission 1.81 proved missing, retrieved for exactly the codes a pre-retrieval freeze names; the class grain derived from held records for every frozen class the procedure admits; and the second-Opportunity candidate re-selected over the whole labelled universe. Authoritative where paired with the generated Markdown; the gate recomputes every census, cohort, derivation, reliability and dominance fact from the frozen universe, the vocabulary slice, the derivation records, the v4 preparation and the reconciliation record.

measured_from.database: live, read for the freeze and the derivation; the derivation wrote canonical rows as recorded below

outcome_basis: one class earns selection under the same gates Missions 1.80 and 1.81 applied, with the semantic blocker resolved rather than argued around. Outcome C -- that the labels show group grain is already actionable -- is HALF true and was refused as the primary: two groups do reach the actionability gate once labelled, which is 1.81's blocker resolved, and deeper narrowing was not thereby unnecessary. Narrowing 926 to 9261 cost zero Evidence rows and gained a strictly more specific label, so the class wins on the recorded rule rather than because it is narrower (§28).

freeze.derivation_basis: sros_nlp.extractors.procurement_value_contrast.ProcurementValueContrastExtractor._cpv_prefix at grain 3 (group) and 4 (class), over every held, non-superseded procurement_notice NormalizedRecord carrying a CPV code in division 92

present_but_not_frozen.why: the freeze took the codes that FORM a cohort under the production membership rule at grain 4, not every code PRESENT on a held notice. These three appear only on notices that also carry another class code, so under C4_REFUSE_AMBIGUOUS_NOTICE they form no cohort at grain 4 and can be no candidate at that grain
present_but_not_frozen.why_not_retrieved: they are outside the frozen universe, and the freeze is what stops a label from changing which codes get looked up. Widening it after labels had been read would be that move with a structural excuse. Recorded here instead, with the counts, so the gap is visible; a future mission that changes the membership model must re-freeze and look them up
present_but_not_frozen.candidate_impact: NONE: no cohort, no packet, no candidate at grain 4

freeze.why_a_freeze: the universe decides which concepts may be looked up. Frozen from held codes and committed first, a label that reads well cannot add a code and one that reads badly cannot remove one; the three class codes present in the population but never unambiguous were left outside and recorded rather than fetched, because widening a freeze after reading labels is the move the freeze exists to stop

retrieval.FIRST_PARTY_AUTHORITY: European Union Publications Office, EU Vocabularies CPV authority register
retrieval.a_retrieval_summary_is_not_a_document: the register returns the concept document itself in RDF/XML, so no summarising extraction sits between the source and this record. Mission 1.63's rule is met by the medium rather than by care
retrieval.hierarchy_corroborates_and_does_not_esta: every retrieved skos:broader agrees with the mechanical code hierarchy. The hierarchy stays established from the CPV token; the agreement is a corroboration

derivation.minimum_basis: MINIMUM_COHORT_MEMBERS in the extractor, re-read from code and unchanged
derivation.selective_derivation_note: every frozen class cohort the procedure admits was derived, including the two-row ones and the classes whose labels turned out to name nothing a product could enter. Semantic and actionability gates were applied AFTERWARDS, so no measurement exists because a label read well (§16)
derivation.convergence_note: 14 Signals produced 14 detailed Claims and 12 witnessed ones, because two pairs of class cohorts from the two acquisition windows converge on one broader proposition each. That is the Mission 1.39 convergence contract doing its work at a grain it had not reached before, and it is why claims and evidence do not move in step

reliability.why_the_existing_scopes_apply: a reliability scope is source, resource, record kind, claim type and proposition kind. It carries no classification level and no code, so a class cohort is the same measurement under the same two proposition kinds as a group or a division cohort. Re-measured through the resolver rather than assumed, and no value was hard-coded: the record states the assessment ids the resolver bound
reliability.what_a_reviewer_could_still_decide: that a finer classification level is a different measurement purpose deserving its own scope. Nothing here forecloses that, and no assessment was created to avoid it

currency_semantics.rule: currency is a cohort key dimension since procurement-value-contrast@1.1.0; two currencies are two cohorts

notice_type_semantics.rule: notice class is a cohort key dimension since procurement-value-contrast@1.0.0

group_reassessment.$comment: Mission 1.81 could not determine actionability because the groups were bare codes. With the official labels, each group is re-evaluated on its own before any descent, and the answer is not uniform: two groups reach the exploratory-category gate, two are disjunctions their own labels and children expose, and two carry no Evidence.

groups.semantic_coherence_basis: the label joins production with an open-ended 'and video services', and its held children are production-and-related and projection: two activities inside one audiovisual domain
radio and television are two broadcast activities in one domain; the held population carries one notice and forms no cohort

'Entertainment services' is a heading over held children that are materially unrelated: artistic and literary creation, recreational areas, gambling and betting, and pyrotechnics. Commissioning an artist, running a park, running betting and setting off fireworks are four markets
news-agency services name one activity; the held population forms no cohort

groups.OFFICIAL_LABEL: Library, archives, museums and other cultural services
groups.semantic_coherence_basis: the official label ends 'and other cultural services', which is the register's own residual wording, and the held children are library and archive services, museum and built-heritage preservation, and botanical and zoological gardens and nature reserves. A library and a zoo are not one market
'Sporting services' names one domain, and both held children -- sports facilities operation and sport-related services -- are inside it

group_reassessment.finding: the labels resolved 1.81's blocker. 926 'Sporting services' and 921 'Motion picture and video services' each denote one procurement domain and reach the exploratory gate at group grain; 923 'Entertainment services' and 925 'Library, archives, museums and other cultural services' do not, and their own official wording is the evidence -- 925's label ends in the register's residual 'and other cultural services', and 923's held children are artistic creation, recreational areas, gambling and pyrotechnics. 922 and 924 are coherent and carry no cohort at all

semantic_coherence_rule.definition: SINGLE_DOMAIN: the official label names one activity. RELATED_ACTIVITIES: it joins activities inside one domain, or ends in an open remainder. UNRELATED_ACTIVITIES: the label or the held children name materially unrelated markets.
semantic_coherence_rule.what_it_is_not: not market attractiveness, not trend, not perceived profitability, not familiarity, not apparent SaaS potential. It asks what the subject MEANS (§12). A subject may be perfectly coherent and commercially uninteresting, and this field would not know
semantic_coherence_rule.not_applicable_note: a product or a bare term has no official classification label, so the field does not apply and decides nothing for or against it in dominance

dominance.rule: X dominates Y when X is at least as good on every dominance field that applies to both and strictly better on at least one; dominance is a veto on the dominated candidate, never a selection rule, and the vetoes are applied independently
dominance.why_the_field_was_added: Mission 1.81's frontier could not separate two equally broad, equally specific categories, because the only thing that distinguishes them is what their labels mean, and no label was held. It is what the retrieval bought, so it enters the model as a field rather than as a tie-break written after the numbers were seen
dominance.frontier_note: four candidates survive dominance. Division 92 keeps a place on breadth alone -- ten rows against six -- and is vetoed on grain, as in Missions 1.80 and 1.81. Kubernetes and podman keep theirs on breadth and specificity and are vetoed on formability, as in both earlier missions. The class 9261 is the only one carrying no veto, and it reached the frontier by dominating its own group on specificity and its equally broad sibling 9252 on coherence -- both computed, neither asserted

group_versus_class.$comment: §28. A class does not win for being narrower; it wins only where narrowing costs no Evidence and buys precision.

pairs.why: the same six rows, the same three counting dimensions, the same two reviewed reliabilities and a strictly more specific label. Narrowing destroyed no Evidence shape and bought precision, which is the only condition under which §28 lets a class defeat its group

pairs.class_label: Motion picture and video tape production and related services
pairs.why: narrowing 921 to 9211 costs two of six Evidence rows and the class label ends in an open 'and related services', so it buys less precision than it costs. Both are dominated by 9261 and neither is vetoed

small_cohort_hazard.$comment: §29. A two-observation contrast is valid and is not thereby strong; the two facts are recorded apart and no minimum N was invented.

selection.SELECTION_BASIS: the only candidate on the recomputed frontier carrying no veto. Its official label names one activity, its six Evidence rows are derived at exactly that code from held records across two acquisition windows, all six are scorable at the reviewed TED reliabilities, and a synthesis can state what authorities publish under it without inventing a problem. It dominates its own group on specificity at equal Evidence and its equally broad sibling on coherence
